corresponding_source.policy: Tag every externally distributed build and archive this repository at that tag, including Package.swift, project.yml, Xcode project, tests, and Scripts/. Upstream submodules are reference-only and are not required to rebuild the Sugarman app binary.

records.source_path: Three timestamped private official-app Android HCI snapshots from one owned active Mainland GS3; Bluetooth SIG Device Information Service and Assigned Numbers
records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: Two independently authored redacting analyzers correlated the connected HCI peer address with a 17-byte textual value read from Device Information characteristic 2A25 in every timestamped snapshot. Only hashes, counts, UUID, value length, match booleans, ATT frame lengths, and the resolved source enum are published. The Bluetooth SIG specifications identify 2A25 as Serial Number String; they do not require it to contain a Bluetooth address.
records.author: chris

records.notes: No raw address, serial string, authentication payload, glucose payload, account data, or device identifier is committed. The evidence passes the P1 source gate for this sensor only; another lot remains a generalization gate. This P1 artifact does not identify a cipher; the separate P2 report records the capture-plus-owned-APK conclusion.

records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: The pinned reference constructs and returns a 26-byte V1.20 authentication command encrypted with its RC4 routine. Sugarman uses only that exact length/cipher behavior as an offline negative comparison against the owned official-app HCI capture; no implementation or key was copied.
records.author: chris

records.notes: Behavioral comparison only. The pinned 26-byte RC4 path does not match the owned app's 38-byte authentication write. Any future adaptation still requires file-level GPL notices and provenance.

records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: Read-only dynamic-symbol and targeted ARM64 disassembly inspection of the owned app verified a V3 JNI authentication call chain through sdk_authid, AesFixedIvXorWithKey, and AES_OFB_encrypt_buffer. The function encrypts and returns 38 bytes, matching the payload-free HCI frame length. Only symbol names, call edges, byte count, and hashes are recorded; no binary code, constants, keys, IVs, or payloads were copied.

records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: An exact four-field NDEF text shape was independently observed on one owned active Mainland GS3. Pinned Juggluco is used only to corroborate NDEF text reading and handling of the final six bytes as an identifier. No upstream expression was copied. Sugarman's bounded parser returns only a redacted serial, does not expose the link identifier, and keeps protocol confidence unknown.
